svg.title: Descriptive Parent Profiles and E7 Outcomes
svg.desc: Separate Qwen and DeepSeek panels partition sixty paired questions by E2 and E6 Strict correctness and show the corresponding E7 outcome. Ribbon widths and box labels represent exact question counts. The accounting is descriptive and does not imply causal transitions.

text.tspan: Descriptive Parent Profiles and E7 Outcomes
Strict-correctness accounting for the same 60 questions under each backbone
Ribbon width and labels encode question count · 1 question = 1.4 px · N = 60 per panel
Preserve/Harm: at least one parent was correct · Repair/Unresolved: neither parent was correct
Lines partition paired questions; they describe outcomes and do not imply causal transitions.
